top_jobs.job: When sales dip for a quarter and I cannot tell if it is us or the market, help me see whether our category is growing or shrinking quarter by quarter, and where we grow slower than it line by line, so I know whether to fix us or ride it out
top_jobs.metric: our growth minus category growth, per product line, quarter against the same quarter last year

top_jobs.job: When a supplier quote, freight rate or tariff moves and margin keeps slipping, help me see which input costs are rising on my top products and who can squeeze my margin, in plain words, so I act before margin shrinks
top_jobs.metric: landed cost per unit for the top 10 SKUs against last quarter

top_jobs.job: When sales on our own site flatten, help me see where buyers in my category are moving and which nearby categories they also buy are growing, so we follow the buyer instead of fighting it
top_jobs.metric: share of category demand by channel (brand sites, Amazon, TikTok Shop, search, AI answers), quarterly

top_jobs.job: When I am about to put $20k or more into a new product, or an idea excites the team, help me check demand from more than one source and margin after every real cost in an hour, and force a go or no-go, so I do not sink cash into a product that will not sell
top_jobs.metric: share of launches that hit their 90 day plan

top_jobs.job: When I am shaping a product or a price, help me see the price bands my category buys in, the price buyers call fair and the complaints no one has fixed, so we build and price for what buyers want
top_jobs.metric: share of our revenue from products priced inside the busiest band

jobs.job: Pull 12 quarters of search demand for 10 to 20 category terms and chart each quarter against the same quarter last year
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then in the first week of each quarter

inputs.need: 10 to 20 category terms, not brand names
monthly search volumes for the terms
longer volume history and more terms
inputs.from: an SEO data source such as OpenSEO

steps: List category terms with the founder: what a buyer types before they know us
Pull monthly volumes and 5 year trend per term
Sum by quarter and compute change against the same quarter last year
Mark terms growing 3 quarters in a row and terms falling 3 in a row
Write 1 line: the category is growing, flat or shrinking, by how much
jobs.output: a quarterly demand chart for the category, with growth against last year and the 1 line call

watch.metric: category search demand, quarter against last year
watch.source: Google Ads Keyword Planner and Trends

jobs.drives: the right fix: us or the market

jobs.job: Compare our revenue growth with the category's growth each quarter, product line by product line, and name the lines where we lose share inside our own growth
jobs.trigger: first week of each quarter

inputs.need: revenue by product line by quarter, 3 years
marketplace revenue if we sell there
which category terms map to which line

steps: Sum our revenue per line per quarter, all channels
Compute our growth against the same quarter last year
Match each line to its category terms and take the category growth
Subtract: our growth minus category growth, per line
Flag lines with a gap worse than minus 10 points for 2 quarters
Write 1 line per flagged line: growing but losing share, or shrinking with the market
jobs.output: a table: line, our growth, category growth, gap, 2 quarter flag

watch.metric: our growth minus category growth per line

jobs.job: Split our search clicks into brand name searches and category searches each quarter, to see if the brand grows faster than the category
jobs.trigger: first week of each quarter

inputs.need: queries with clicks and impressions, 16 months

steps: Pull Search Console queries by month
Tag each query as brand, category or other with a word list
Sum clicks and impressions per quarter for each group
Compare brand search growth with category demand growth
Write the call: brand pulling ahead, keeping pace or falling behind
jobs.output: a quarterly brand vs category search table with the call
jobs.next: feeds 02 brand health and 12 brand search spend

watch.metric: brand search clicks against last year

jobs.job: Before cutting a product line that slid 2 quarters, check whether the market, the product or our ads are to blame
jobs.trigger: when a line falls 2 quarters in a row

inputs.need: line revenue, conversion and repeat rate by quarter
review rating and themes by quarter
ad spend, reach and cost per purchase for the line

steps: Check category demand for the line: down, flat or up
Check the product: rating trend, new complaint themes, return rate
Check our push: spend, reach and cost per purchase against last year
Name the likely cause with the 2 numbers that show it
Propose: fix product, fix ads, reprice, or wind down, with cash freed
jobs.output: a 1 page line diagnosis with a cause and a proposal
jobs.next: feeds 19 supply (stock plan) and 09 creative if ads are to blame

watch.metric: line revenue against category trend

jobs.job: Map category demand month by month for each market we sell in, and set the start date for stock, creative and cash before each peak
jobs.trigger: once a year in January, checked each quarter
steps: Index demand by month for each market, average of the last 3 years
Lay our own weekly orders over it
Mark peaks, dead zones and where we under sold a peak
Count back lead time from each peak to set stock, creative and cash dates
Put the dates on the calendar shelf
jobs.output: a 12 month demand map per market with prep dates on the calendar
jobs.next: feeds 00 Today alerts and 19 purchase orders

watch.metric: orders in peak weeks against last year

jobs.job: Build an input cost tracker for the top 10 SKUs: factory price, freight, duty, packaging and fulfilment per unit, each quarter, and flag any rise over 5 percent
jobs.trigger: first week of each quarter, and when a quote or freight invoice lands

inputs.from: a Google Sheet kept by ops

inputs.need: public freight and raw material indices

steps: List the top 10 SKUs by gross profit
Split landed cost per unit into 5 parts from the latest invoices
Compare each part with last quarter and last year
Flag parts up over 5 percent and the gross profit at stake per month
Check public indices to say if more rises are coming
jobs.output: a landed cost table for the top 10 SKUs with flags and dollars at stake
jobs.next: feeds 04-15 (raise price, change pack or absorb) and 21 finance

watch.metric: landed cost per unit, top 10 SKUs

jobs.job: When a tariff or duty change is announced, compute the cost per unit for each product it hits and the 3 options: reprice, reroute or order early
jobs.trigger: the day a tariff or trade rule is announced

inputs.need: country of origin and customs code per SKU
stock on hand and open orders

steps: List SKUs by country of origin and customs code
Apply the new rate and compute extra cost per unit and per month
Check stock on hand and open orders: how many units land before the date
Cost 3 options: raise price, move supplier, place an order early
Write the pick with the cash it needs
jobs.output: a tariff hit table per SKU and a costed choice of 3 options

watch.metric: gross margin on hit SKUs

jobs.job: Write the five forces for our category in plain words: who can squeeze our margin (suppliers, marketplaces and ad platforms, rivals, cheaper substitutes, new sellers), each with evidence and a 1 to 5 pressure score
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then each quarter

inputs.need: marketplace fees and ad cost trends
new sellers in the category this quarter

steps: Write 1 plain line per force: who, how they squeeze us, the evidence
Score each force 1 to 5 and compare with last quarter
Name the force that rose the most
Write 1 push back per force: dual source, raise price, own the channel, own a claim
Founder checks the scores and signs
jobs.output: a 1 page forces sheet: 5 lines, scores, the rising force and the push back

watch.metric: pressure score of the top force

jobs.job: Check whether the cost to reach a buyer is rising for us or for the whole category, by comparing our CPM and cost per click with the category benchmark each month
jobs.trigger: monthly, and when cost per purchase rises 2 months running

inputs.need: our CPM, cost per click and cost per purchase by month
category benchmark for the same months
inputs.from: Meta industry benchmark and Google auction insights

steps: Pull our monthly CPM, cost per click and cost per purchase for 12 months
Pull the category benchmark for the same months
Index both to 100 at the start and plot
If ours rose faster, point to our creative and page; if both rose, it is the category
Write the 1 line call and the next job
jobs.output: a 12 month chart of our cost against the category's, with the call
jobs.next: feeds 09 creative (if it is us) or 21 finance (if it is the category)

watch.metric: our CPM against category CPM

jobs.job: Track where buyers in the category are moving each quarter: brand sites, Amazon, TikTok Shop, search and AI answers, with a share for each
jobs.trigger: first week of each quarter

inputs.need: Search Console and Google category volume
what AI assistants say for 20 buyer questions

steps: Pull category demand for each channel for the last 8 quarters
Convert each to a share of the total
Compare with where our own orders come from
Name the channel gaining the most share and the one we are thin in
Write 1 move: list there, test ads there, or hold
jobs.output: a channel share table with our mix next to the category's and 1 move

watch.metric: our share of orders from the fastest growing channel

jobs.drives: revenue from where buyers are going

jobs.job: List 5 to 10 allied categories our buyers also buy, check which are growing, and rank the top 3 to grow into
jobs.trigger: twice a year, before range planning

inputs.need: frequently bought together in the category

steps: Collect allied categories from the survey, marketplace pairings and reviews
Pull 8 quarters of demand for each
Score each: growth, fit with our buyer's job, fit with our supply
Rank and keep the top 3
Write 1 test per category: a bundle, a partner or a small run
jobs.output: a ranked list of 3 allied categories with a first test each

watch.metric: revenue from allied category tests

jobs.job: Find uses buyers found for our product that we never planned, count them in reviews and chats, and size each use as its own search market
jobs.trigger: twice a year

inputs.need: current product uses we sell for

steps: Search reviews and chats for use words: for my, I use it to, works for
Group uses and count mentions
Drop uses we already sell for
Pull search volume for each new use
Pick 1 use to test with 2 ads and a page block
jobs.output: a list of unplanned uses with mentions and search volume, and 1 test

watch.metric: sales from the new use angle

jobs.job: Catch search terms and needs in the category that grew 3 months in a row, from Google, Search Console, site search and Amazon
jobs.trigger: first Monday of each month
steps: Pull terms from each source for the last 6 months
Keep terms up 3 months in a row and over a minimum volume
Group them by need
Check if we have a product, page or ad for each need
Send the top 3 needs to product, SEO and creative
jobs.output: a monthly list of rising needs with our coverage for each
jobs.next: feeds 17 SEO briefs, 09 creative and 01-14 (kill test)

watch.metric: clicks on pages built for rising terms

jobs.job: Run a 1 hour kill test on any new product idea: demand from 2 sources, margin after every cost, room for ad cost, seller count and rules, then call go, no-go or drop
jobs.trigger: whenever an idea is raised, before any samples

inputs.need: search volume and trend for the idea

inputs.from: Amazon best sellers or a marketplace data tool

steps: Check demand in 2 sources: search trend and marketplace sales
Compute margin: price minus landed cost, fees, shipping, returns
Compute ad room: margin minus the category's cost per purchase
Count sellers and check rules and certifications
Score and call go, no-go or drop; log the date and reason
jobs.output: a 1 page scorecard with a go, no-go or drop call

watch.metric: ideas decided within 1 week

jobs.job: When a product in our category goes viral, check if it is 1 clip or real demand: 3 or more videos over 1 million views, a search rise and marketplace rank moving
jobs.trigger: within 48 hours of the team spotting it

inputs.need: search trend for the product words

inputs.from: a marketplace rank tool such as Keepa

steps: Count videos on the product over 1 million views from different creators
Check search trend for the last 90 days
Check marketplace rank for the top 3 listings
Call it noise, a fad or real demand
If real, run the kill test in 01-14
jobs.output: a 1 line call with the 3 checks behind it

watch.metric: viral ideas taken to kill test that pass

jobs.job: Bring a ranked idea list with a go or no-go note to the monthly product meeting, and force a decision on any idea in research for over 4 weeks
jobs.trigger: monthly, 2 days before the product meeting
steps: Pull every idea with its score and age
Rank by score and fit with goals
Mark ideas over 4 weeks old as decide today
Write 1 line per idea: go, no-go, drop, and the reason
Log decisions and close dropped cards
jobs.output: a ranked list of ideas with decisions logged
jobs.next: feeds 19 supply (samples and orders) and 00 Today board

watch.metric: ideas older than 4 weeks without a decision

jobs.drives: team time on ideas with a chance

jobs.job: Compare each new product's first 90 days with its launch plan: units, price, margin, ad cost and repeat rate, and fix the launch math for next time
jobs.trigger: 90 days after each launch

inputs.need: units, revenue and returns for 90 days
ad spend and purchases for the product

steps: Pull 90 day actuals for the product
Put actual next to plan for each line of the scorecard
Name the 2 biggest misses and why
Change the scorecard rule that caused the miss
Log the result in the history shelf
jobs.output: a plan vs actual sheet and 1 changed rule

watch.metric: launch plan error on units and margin

jobs.job: Track which price bands the category's best sellers sit in each quarter, and whether buyers are trading down or up
jobs.trigger: first week of each quarter

inputs.need: top 50 category best sellers with prices
inputs.from: Amazon best sellers and rival sites

inputs.need: unit rule for the category, like per pair

steps: Pull prices and pack sizes for the top 50 sellers
Convert to price per unit and set 4 to 5 bands
Count best sellers per band and compare with last quarter
Place each of our products on the band chart
Write the call: trading down, up or steady, and what it means for our range
jobs.output: a band chart with our products placed and the quarter's call

watch.metric: share of our revenue in the busiest band

jobs.job: Mine reviews of the top 10 category products for the price buyers call fair or too much and the complaints no seller has fixed
jobs.trigger: before a new product or a price change, and twice a year

inputs.need: reviews for the top 10 category products

steps: Pull up to 500 reviews per product, 1 to 5 stars
Tag each for price words (worth it, overpriced) and complaint themes
Count themes and mark ones every seller has
Pull the price where worth it turns to overpriced
Write 3 build notes and 1 price note
jobs.output: a review sheet: unfixed complaints ranked, fair price line, 3 build notes

watch.metric: rating of the product built from the notes

jobs.job: Pick the next product for the best selling line from what buyers ask for in search, emails and reviews, checked against market demand
jobs.trigger: twice a year, before range planning

inputs.need: site search terms with no result
tickets and reviews asking for something we do not sell

steps: Collect every ask for a product, size, color or pack we do not sell
Group and count the asks
Check search demand for the top 5
Run the top 2 through the kill test
Write why it differs from what we have and who it is for
jobs.output: a shortlist of 2 next products with asks, demand and a kill test each

watch.metric: revenue from the next product in its first 90 days

jobs.drives: new revenue from the best line

new_enablers.name: Price band map
new_enablers.what: Collects prices for the category's top sellers on rival sites and marketplaces, puts them in bands per unit (per pair, per ounce, per pack), counts best sellers in each band and tracks the mix each quarter. Shows where our products sit.
inputs: rival site prices and pack sizes
marketplace best seller lists with prices
a unit rule per category (per pair, per ounce)
powers: where most buyers buy on price
whether the category trades up or down
our price index against the rival median

new_enablers.name: Launch scorecard
new_enablers.what: A fixed go or no-go test for any product idea: demand from 2 or more sources, margin after landed cost, fees, returns and ad cost, room for ad cost under the category's cost per purchase, number of sellers, rebuy rate, and rules to clear. Every idea gets the same score, a date and a decision.
inputs: rules and certifications for the category
powers: a go, no-go or drop call in an hour
a ranked idea list for the product meeting
